name: pbiplint
description: Lint Power BI projects: build issues, a run summary, and a SARIF report.
helpMarkDown: Runs [pbiplint](https://pbiplint.com) on a Power BI project, its semantic model and its report. [More](https://github.com/pbiplint/azure-pipelines#readme)
author: McKinley Consulting

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to lint, relative to the pipeline's working folder (the repository, in a job with one checkout): a PBIP folder, a .pbip file, a .SemanticModel or .Report folder, a definition folder, or one .tmdl file.

inputs.name: failOn
inputs.label: Fail on
inputs.helpMarkDown: Lowest severity that fails the step: error, warning, info, or none.

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Config file
inputs.helpMarkDown: A pbiplint.config.json to use. By default the nearest one above the project applies.

inputs.name: pbiplintVersion
inputs.label: pbiplint version
inputs.helpMarkDown: The pbiplint CLI version to run, as an npm version spec. Each release of this task pins the current one.

inputs.name: annotations
inputs.label: Build issues
inputs.helpMarkDown: Report findings as build issues with their file and line. The agent shows at most 10 errors and 10 warnings per step; the summary always has every finding.

inputs.name: publishSarif
inputs.label: Publish the SARIF report
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish the SARIF report as a build artifact, which the SARIF SAST Scans Tab extension shows.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The artifact the SARIF report goes to. The SARIF SAST Scans Tab reads only CodeAnalysisLogs.

inputs.name: sarifCategory
inputs.label: Report name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The name of this step's report files. Give each step its own when one job lints several projects.

outputVariables.name: exitCode
outputVariables.description: pbiplint's exit code: 0 no findings at or above failOn, 1 findings at or above failOn, 2 usage or input error, or pbiplint could not run.
